name: Nene
source:
Age: Appears as 15
Specialization: Environment Control
Main Element: Wind
Secondary Element: Earth
History: Nene has come in Astral around the same time as Iori, she is her girlfriend and Lumen's friend.
Personality: Similar to Iori, Nene is cheerfuller, easygoing and friendly but unlike Iori she is quite girlish.
Nene enjoys teasing people and quite often ends up overdoing it. Despite this she can be very easily embarrassed when someone
turns teasing on her.
